title: zoomroom
description: Device config entry for a device of type "zoomroom". Properties object for a device of type "zoomroom", backed by ZoomRoomPropertiesConfig (ZoomRoomPropertiesConfig.cs).

key.description: Unique identifier for this device within the configuration file.

name.description: Friendly display name for this device.

type.description: Discriminator identifying the plugin factory that instantiates this device.

properties.description: Properties object for a device of type "zoomroom", backed by ZoomRoomPropertiesConfig (ZoomRoomPropertiesConfig.cs).

communicationMonitorProperties.description: Kept for back-compat but is no longer used - the ZRC SDK is event-driven and requires no polling.

showMultiSpeakerLayout.description: Whether to offer "Multi-Speaker" as a selectable layout. The ZRC SDK exposes no command to enter Multi-Speaker, so the button is a no-op if pressed. Defaults to false (hidden).

autoDefaultLayouts.description: If true, the layouts will be set automatically when sharing starts/ends or a call is joined.

defaultSharingLayout.description: Layout selected when Sharing starts (either from far end or locally).

defaultCallLayout.description: Layout selected when a call is connected and no content is being shared.

meetingInviteTimeoutMs.description: How long (ms) a ringing meeting invite is allowed to sit unanswered before it's dropped from ActiveCalls. Defaults to 45000 (45s) when unset/0.

phoneDialMode.description: How DialPhoneCall places outbound calls. Sip (default) uses the SDK's SIP phone service; Pstn is not yet implemented. Case-insensitive.

layoutStyle.description: Zoom Room Controller layout style (bit-flag enum; a single value is typically used per field). Case-insensitive.
